主体设定：<Subject 1> 是 <Picture 1> 画面左侧的男性，保留束起的发髻、短须与沉静的脸，宽大厚重、袍摆拖地的深色长袍，腰间一长一短两柄刀，右手长刀；<Subject 2> 是 <Picture 1> 画面右侧的男性，保留束起的发髻与清瘦的脸，深色衣装外肩披边缘毛糙的粗布披风，刀柄垂着绳穗，右手长刀；<Subject 3> 是 <Picture 1> 中的竹林空地：湿透的深色石板地、贴地的雾、两侧密集竹林。动作中两人的身份与整套服装不变。

概述：[参考生成] 风从左吹向右的竹林空地上，<Subject 1> 以长刀大弧守住身前一整圈刀圈，一步一刀向前压；<Subject 2> 要破开这道刀圈、贴进他一步之内。前者斩倒竹子封住后者的路线，后者借倒竹与弯竹的回弹两次突入，最后用刀柄撞落对方的长刀，两人在新位置继续交锋。

视觉：写实电影质感，低饱和青灰冷调，雾、湿地反光与竹林纵深层层分明，冷白天光从竹林顶端漫下勾出两人轮廓。两人都束发、衣着深色，以短须与厚袍、清瘦与披风区分，换位后也不混淆。刀刀相撞的火星是全片唯一的暖色，只在接触点一闪即灭，不是光效；竹子倒下的方向由斩击方向决定。空地右侧竹林边那根最粗的竹竿是固定地标，全片位置不变。无血，画面无文字水印。

[Shot 1] 贴地低位广景，从右侧竹林边穿过前景竹竿看向空地，雾被风拉成贴地的带子。<Subject 1> 从左侧压来，长刀一记大弧扫满身前；<Subject 2> 从右侧低身冲进，刀尖直取他的前膝。大弧的刀背砸在 <Subject 2> 刀身中段，把刀尖压进积水、划出一道水线，火星与水花同时炸起，<Subject 2> 被弹回刀圈外。他借回弹再冲，<Subject 1> 不砍人，横刀齐腰斩断他前方两根竹竿，竹子一前一后横倒封路；<Subject 2> 贴着湿石板从第一根竹子下方滑过，水花扇形铺开，第二根正从他头顶压下。

[Shot 2] 00:05.000 切绕行的全身机位，刚倒下的竹竿仍横在两人之间，那根最粗的竹竿在画面右侧。<Subject 2> 一脚蹬上正在倒下的竹竿，借倾倒变向跃起，从高处斜劈；<Subject 1> 双手横刀架在头顶，两刀相交处迸出火星，这一劈的分量把他压得单膝砸进积水。他借最低的重心整身一拧，肩膀由下往上撞进 <Subject 2> 胸口；<Subject 2> 倒飞出去，后背撞上那根最粗的竹竿，竹子整根弯到极限、竹叶倾泻。竹子回弹，把他整个人弹回来，正迎上 <Subject 1> 刚抡满的第二记大弧：两刀正撞，<Subject 2> 的刀几乎脱手，手腕被砸得向后折，身体被带着转了半圈。<Subject 1> 的长刀停在弧尾，厚袍慢半拍向后甩开，持刀手的另一侧露出空门。

[Shot 3] 00:10.000 切更低、更广的视角，地上横着被斩倒的竹竿与一道道水痕。<Subject 2> 顺着这半圈旋转压到最低，从还没收回的长刀下方钻进刀圈，贴到 <Subject 1> 持刀手的另一侧，两人左右换位。他反手用刀柄尾端猛撞长刀的护手根部：刀先被撞得一偏，才从 <Subject 1> 右手脱出，翻转着甩过 <Subject 2> 肩头，扎进那根最粗的竹竿，刀身震颤，竹叶纷落。<Subject 1> 左手已拔出腰间短刀横在身前，<Subject 2> 后撤半步沉低，刀尖对准他，两人随即再次移动脚步。扎在竹上的长刀保留在身后，两人的面孔、衣装与新的站位都清楚。

声音：风穿竹林的持续呼啸与竹叶沙沙声，湿石板上的脚步与滑行水声，长刀大弧沉厚的破风、快刀尖细的哨音，刀刀相撞的金属炸响，竹竿断裂的脆响与弯竹回弹的弹响，刀柄撞上护手的一记钝响，长刀扎进竹竿后的余颤。无对白或喊招式名。配乐以低沉太鼓与尺八渐紧，仅在长刀被撞脱手时加入一次重鼓。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> (S1) is the red-eyed heroine from <Picture 1>: short black bob with white underlayer, light neutral ivory skin, matte navy academy jacket with red piping, plaid skirt, black boots and gold insignia. BOTH hands are empty throughout. Her ONE katana already sank fully beneath the plaza in B1 and never reappears; no scabbard. Only her anatomical RIGHT arm performs ONE empty-handed downward knife-hand chop. Her LEFT arm does not attack. Her saturated scarlet-red fighting aura is ALREADY ACTIVE at 00:00, rises from her feet and wraps her body throughout the crimson close-up and raised-arm shot; do not let it vanish between cuts. This existing aura is separate from the later colossal impact curtain.
<Subject 2> (S2) is the silver-haired, golden-eyed male mage from <Picture 2>, in a matte dark-blue-and-gold coat with teal lining and gloves, initially holding ONE blue-crystal staff. He begins hovering at the established far screen-RIGHT position, with his ice array suspended before S1. He is hit in midair on that same right side, then DROPS STRAIGHT DOWN VERTICALLY along one fixed screen-right x-position, with no forward or sideways travel. Seen in a LOCKED EXTREME WIDE, he stays a tiny figure through the fall and a tiny dot after landing; his one staff separates during descent.
<Subject 3> is the SAME dry-stone Gothic academy plaza from <Picture 3>: fixed diagonal elevated bridge, pointed arches and towers, dry tiled ground and warm-lit windows. S1 remains screen LEFT; S2 remains screen RIGHT. Preserve the same camera axis and physical architecture throughout the crimson, black-and-white and restored blue-night states.
<Picture 3> is the B1-to-B2 handoff. BEFORE GENERATION replace this package's placeholder with the ACTUAL LAST FRAME extracted from the generated B1 video. Use it as B2's EXACT 00:00 FIRST FRAME in keyframe completion mode: time already stopped, S1 unarmed at left, S2 hovering upper-right, all ice tips still in FRONT of S1 with visible empty air, and the sword fully underground.
<Picture 4> is a LATER EXTREME MOUTH CLOSE-UP during her quiet Chinese line “断绝”: preserve S1's original light neutral skin, emotionless face and slight three-quarter angle. Lips part only narrowly for the syllables, without showing a wide mouth, teeth or tongue. Her already-active scarlet fighting aura visibly flames around her hair, neck and shoulder edges without tinting her ivory face. The crimson academy is behind her. This is not the opening image.
<Picture 5> is the LATER low rear preparation angle: S1's EMPTY anatomical RIGHT arm rises from her screen-right shoulder FULLY STRAIGHT high overhead, joined fingers flat like a knife-hand; her left arm hangs down. Scarlet fighting aura already rises from BOTH BOOTS and wraps her ENTIRE body and raised arm. This is before the chop and before the separate impact curtain.
<Picture 6> is the LATER EXTREME WIDE mid-release view: a single colossal near-vertical RED-BLACK ink-like IMPACT CURTAIN erupts from S1's WHOLE BODY at screen LEFT and travels toward S2 at screen RIGHT. Behind its moving boundary the SAME bridge and plaza turn stark BLACK AND WHITE; ahead of it they are still crimson. Use its epic scale and geography, then continue the curtain to S2's visible midair hit.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] A 10-second clean hand-drawn 2D anime climax beginning on B1's actual frozen-crimson last frame. In an emotionless mouth close-up S1 murmurs “断绝” in a LOW, FLAT, COOL, UNFORCED female voice, raises her empty right arm straight overhead, and gives one precise downward knife-hand chop. A vast body-originated red-black curtain divides the same plaza into crimson and black-and-white. Her pre-existing scarlet aura remains visible in both new heroine shots. Its hit on the hovering mage freezes the ENTIRE IMAGE at the exact midair hit for a FULL 1.2 seconds BEFORE he starts to fall; this is the primary dramatic pause. From that hit through the end, the camera is LOCKED in ONE unchanged extreme-wide frame. He drops STRAIGHT DOWN at the same screen-right x-coordinate, remains a tiny figure and then a tiny ground dot. The fall and landing stay black-and-white and silent. Keep the monochrome wide landing for a full second with faint dust and aura motion, then restore ordinary blue night in the SAME frame. No close-up or camera follow.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - exact red-eyed identity, original light neutral skin, matte uniform, empty hands, powerful scarlet aura carried continuously from B1, and cold restraint; one anatomical right-arm chop only.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved - same mage, one staff, upper-right hover, full 1.2-second WHOLE-FRAME hard-freeze at the MID-AIR impact before any descent, then a purely VERTICAL fall at one fixed screen-right coordinate; tiny unconscious ground dot in the same locked extreme-wide view.
<Subject 3>: fully_preserved - one dry Gothic academy plaza, fixed diagonal bridge, dry tiles, arches and stable left-right positions through every color state.
<Picture 3> (handoff): fully_copy as exact 00:00 FIRST FRAME after replacing this placeholder with B1's actual video last frame; do not replay the sword, ice launch or time-stop transition.
<Picture 4> (spoken mouth): partially_preserved - keep the extreme mouth framing, original skin tone, emotionless face and visible pre-existing scarlet aura around the body edges; animate only tiny, controlled lip movements for two syllables.
<Picture 5> (raised right hand): partially_preserved - preserve the rear camera, fully straight anatomical RIGHT arm, empty hand and strong scarlet aura rooted at both boots and wrapping the whole body; animate the rise into this pose and its one downward chop.
<Picture 6> (monumental curtain): partially_preserved - preserve the epic wide scale, tiny characters, single curtain and moving crimson-to-monochrome boundary; continue to the impact, freeze the ENTIRE image at the male's midair hit for 1.2 seconds, then keep the exact same locked wide frame for his fall.

detailed_description:
10 seconds, 16:9. Clean hand-drawn Japanese TV-anime 2D key animation: crisp outlines, flat MATTE local colors, hard cel shadows, restrained highlights, graphic painted ice and ink-like impact effects. No glossy/PBR materials, photoreal ice, volumetric CGI or reflective wet ground. S1 has a strong scarlet fighting aura ALREADY BURNING from her feet around her whole body before she says her line, and it remains continuous through the mouth close-up, raised-arm pose and chop; it does not disappear or flare into the later world-scale curtain until the chop finishes. Color states are STORY EFFECTS on the SAME physical plaza: crimson time stop, stark BLACK AND WHITE at release/impact/fall/landing, then ordinary deep-blue night. HARD ICE RULE: no cone touches, grazes, overlaps, crosses or passes S1, or appears behind her, at any point. Every tip remains in FRONT/SCREEN-RIGHT of S1 with visible empty air until the curtain erases it.

[00:00.0-00:00.4 | exact inherited stillness] Begin with <Picture 3> as the literal first image frame using the ACTUAL B1 final video frame. S1 stands LEFT with both hands empty; her sword is fully underground. S2 and his single staff are suspended upper-RIGHT. Blue ice cones have stopped short of S1. The same plaza is already crimson and time has already stopped. Do not replay any B1 event.

[00:00.4-00:01.3 | emotionless mouth close-up] CUT to <Picture 4>: a tight three-quarter EXTREME CLOSE-UP centered on S1's mouth and chin, with only a small part of her eye visible. Preserve her original light neutral ivory skin. Her face stays utterly expressionless, eyes aimed toward S2 off-screen right; no smile, grimace, lifted brow or clenched teeth. She speaks <d>[Chinese] 断绝</d> in a low-register, close, calm female voice: flat pitch, steady soft volume, almost an under-the-breath statement, with no push on either syllable. This is cool certainty, never anger or an attack shout. No rising or falling dramatic intonation, no growl, no whispery strain, no breathy gasp, no reverberant heroic delivery. Keep the vocal intensity the same on 断 and 绝; let the line end naturally without force or an emphatic tail. Her lips open only a few millimeters, with minimal two-syllable articulation; no wide open mouth, shout, visible teeth or exaggerated lip sync. Finish the full line before her arm starts rising. Her pre-existing red aura is plainly visible behind the edges of her hair, neck and shoulder, but her face remains neutral ivory. Only S1 is visible; no subtitle.

[00:01.3-00:02.4 | straight right arm] Cut to low rear three-quarter view, same left ground mark. Her EMPTY anatomical RIGHT arm, attached to the SCREEN-RIGHT shoulder in this rear view, rises smoothly HIGH overhead until shoulder, elbow, wrist and joined fingertips form one STRAIGHT extended line. Palm flat, fingers together like a knife-hand. LEFT arm lowered and empty. Reach <Picture 5> and hold the silhouette briefly. Boots remain planted. S2 stays far upper-RIGHT; every cone stays frozen in front of her with a visible gap. Her existing scarlet aura continues visibly from both boots up the full body and raised arm; do not switch it off. No premature WORLD-SCALE energy curtain.

[00:02.4-00:02.8 | one downward command] Her RIGHT shoulder drives ONE precise, fast downward knife-hand chop from high overhead to low in front of her torso, ending in a clear final pose. One crisp hand-drawn motion smear. The empty hand touches nothing: no ground, ice, staff or mage. LEFT arm stays quiet. Only at the exact frame the right hand FINISHES descending, release ONE red-black curtain from S1's WHOLE BODY at her exact left-side position. The curtain is not a sword slash, hand-held beam, circular shield or floor shockwave.

[00:02.8-00:04.1 | monumental division] Rapidly pull back to a true EXTREME WIDE showing the fixed diagonal bridge, towers, dry tiles and both tiny characters. The opaque RED-BLACK ink-painted IMPACT CURTAIN erupts from S1's WHOLE BODY at screen LEFT and sweeps toward S2 upper-RIGHT. The same plaza behind its edge becomes stark BLACK AND WHITE; ahead remains crimson. Match <Picture 6> as the moving mid-sweep composition. The curtain erases all frozen ice before any cone reaches S1. At its first appearance cut ALL AUDIO to absolute silence. By 00:04.1 its leading edge is a breath away from S2.

[00:04.1-00:04.2 | unmistakable contact] In the SAME extreme-wide, the curtain TOUCHES the hovering S2 at exactly 00:04.1. His blue aura cuts out. Draw one crisp monochrome ink-outline silhouette at the exact contact point around his tiny upper-right body. His body jolts into an impacted pose but DOES NOT BEGIN TO FALL. Lock the camera here: exact same bridge, plaza, tiny S1 at left and S2 at upper-right, same lens, scale and angle through 00:10.0.

[00:04.2-00:05.4 | PRIMARY FREEZE: 1.2 FULL SECONDS AT THE HIT] IMMEDIATELY ON IMPACT, HARD-FREEZE THE ENTIRE VIDEO IMAGE as one held 2D animation cel for a continuous, plainly visible 1.2 SECONDS. This is an EDITORIAL FREEZE-FRAME, NOT slow motion: repeat the EXACT SAME drawing/frame without interpolation or camera movement from 00:04.2 until 00:05.4. S2 remains fixed high in the air at his hit coordinates with NO downward displacement at all; his body, hair, coat, staff, impact ink outline, curtain, ice dust, S1 and the whole black-and-white plaza ALL STOP MOVING together. No particle drift, camera shake, zoom, cut or color change during this midair freeze. This is the ONLY full-picture stop in this clip. Place it HERE AT THE HIT, not after the landing or at the end. It must read as a deliberate one-second-plus full-frame freeze before gravity resumes. Absolute silence.

[00:05.4-00:07.4 | vertical fall after freeze] At exactly 00:05.4 UNFREEZE the picture; only now does S2 begin to fall. The impact outline disperses, the curtain continues past him, and a few particles resume movement. Keep the entire world BLACK AND WHITE and the camera PERFECTLY LOCKED in the same extreme-wide: no cut, pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, tracking or reframe. S2 drops STRAIGHT DOWN from his upper-right impact point along ONE VERTICAL SCREEN LINE at the SAME x-coordinate, to the dry stone directly beneath him. He stays a tiny figure, never growing larger or moving toward S1/camera. His ONE staff slips from his hand during descent and lands nearby. At 00:07.4 he hits the right-side tiles with a tiny dust flicker and comes to rest as a tiny ground dot. No kneeling, bracing, recovery, teleport or counterattack. The fall and landing remain silent and monochrome.

[00:07.4-00:08.4 | one black-and-white second after landing, NOT a freeze-frame] Remain in the EXACT SAME LOCKED extreme-wide black-and-white composition for one full second after S2 lands, but DO NOT FREEZE THE VIDEO IMAGE again. The mage himself lies motionless as a tiny dot at screen RIGHT; faint dust continues to drift and S1's scarlet aura subtly flickers at screen LEFT, showing that time is moving normally. The camera does not move. This is a monochrome elapsed-time interval, not a second hit-stop, still completely silent. Do not put the main dramatic pause here.

[00:08.4-00:10.0 | color returns while time continues] Only after that post-landing second, ordinary deep-blue night and warm amber windows return across the exact SAME fixed extreme-wide frame. Keep subtle normal motion in the air, dust and S1's aura; do not freeze the picture or extend a static pose as the climax. S2 remains unconscious as a tiny unmoving ground dot on the right, directly beneath his former hovering position, his one staff separately beside him. S1 remains a small standing figure at left with both hands empty, watching him. No close-up, insert, tracking, pan, tilt, zoom, new camera angle, extra attack or new pose. End at 00:10.0.
overall_soundscape:
At 00:00 carry B1's near-total time-stop hush. S1's one Chinese line “断绝” is voiced by a low-register female voice, very close and dry, at soft even volume and almost level pitch; it is an unforced cold murmur, never a projected yell, dramatic whisper, growl, emotional threat or accented battle cry. A faint cloth shift marks her arm rising; a brief sleeve swish marks the single chop. At the curtain's FIRST appearance around 00:02.8, cut EVERYTHING to absolute silence: no impact boom, wind, ice crack, falling whistle, body thud, voice, ambience or music. Keep silence through the FULL 1.2-SECOND HARD FREEZE of the ENTIRE PICTURE at the midair hit from 00:04.2 to 00:05.4, the resumed black-and-white fall, the distant landing and the separate one-second black-and-white post-landing interval, during which dust and aura still move. Only when normal blue night returns around 00:08.4 may faint ordinary plaza night ambience resume. No further dialogue.
